runtimeEscalation.reason: The Skill only compares project metadata and hashes.

caseAssertions.normal-input: Build creates a deterministic session snapshot.
caseAssertions.invalid-input: Invalid session and project-relative paths are rejected.
caseAssertions.denied-expansion: Baseline and output paths cannot escape ProjectRoot.
caseAssertions.repeat-idempotency: Repeated Build yields the same snapshot hash for unchanged bytes.
caseAssertions.hash-change-cache-invalidation: Changed Skill metadata or resource hashes produce a delta.
caseAssertions.interruption-recovery: A written baseline can be compared after a later session invocation.
caseAssertions.deterministic-output: Sorted paths and stable hashes produce deterministic output.

responsibilityScope: Static acceptance for incremental Skill discovery; it does not prove that a model consumed or understood a Skill.

specializedAcceptance.title: Incremental Skill discovery and session invalidation
specializedAcceptance.runtimeBoundary: Static checks prove metadata drift detection, not AI comprehension or execution success.
